definitions.catchment-hydrology-impervious-surface-c: Watershed land-cover pressure on catchment hydrology. Scored automatically on the more limiting of two indicators: impervious cover (speeds runoff) or agricultural cover (where farming, not pavement, is the dominant hydrologic alteration).
definitions.surface-water-storage-percent-wetlands-i: Share of the watershed that is wetland, which stores water, buffers peak flows, and sustains baseflow.
definitions.reach-inflow-concentrated-runoff-stormwa: Road density in the watershed, a stand-in for concentrated runoff pressure. It does not count actual outfalls or crossings.
definitions.streamflow-regime-flow-alteration-regula: Degree of regulation: upstream reservoir storage relative to the river's annual runoff volume. It does not account for how dams are operated or for diversions.
definitions.low-flow-and-baseflow-dynamics-low-flow-: Whether the channel stays wetted and longitudinally connected during low-flow periods (flow permanence).
definitions.high-flow-dynamics-floodplain-engagement: How readily high flows reach the floodplain, from the bank-height ratio rather than a modeled recurrence interval.
definitions.floodplain-connectivity-floodplain-acces: Whether the channel has lateral access to a floodplain, via the entrenchment ratio (floodprone width ÷ bankfull width).
definitions.hyporheic-connectivity-hyporheic-exchang: Potential for surface water to exchange with the shallow subsurface (hyporheic zone), scored on the better of two pathways: channel slope (vertical bedform-driven exchange) or reach sinuosity (lateral meander-driven exchange).
definitions.channel-evolution-channel-evolution-stag: Whether the channel is stable or actively incising/widening, its stage in the channel-evolution sequence.
definitions.channel-and-floodplain-dynamics-bank-ero: Susceptibility to bank erosion, from the bank-height ratio unless bank observations are entered. The proxy does not detect existing armoring.
definitions.sediment-continuity-sediment-supply-pote: Potential for excess sediment from watershed sources, scored on the most limiting of agricultural cover, soil erodibility, and road density. Bank-derived supply is not represented.
definitions.bed-composition-and-large-wood-substrate: Quality of the streambed substrate (grain size, embeddedness, fines) that supports habitat and spawning.
definitions.light-and-thermal-regime-stream-temperat: Vulnerability to warming, scored on the more limiting of woody riparian shade and watershed impervious cover. It does not estimate stream temperature.
definitions.carbon-processing-detrital-processing-cp: Potential supply of organic matter from riparian vegetation (forest, shrub, grassland, and wetland combined). It does not measure litter retention or shredder populations.
definitions.nutrient-cycling-nitrogen-and-phosphorus: Whether nutrient (N and P) concentrations stay near reference levels rather than driving enrichment.
definitions.water-and-soil-quality-regulatory-impair: Whether the reach is on a Clean Water Act impaired-waters list (303(d)/305(b)/TMDL) for water-quality problems.
definitions.habitat-provision-in-stream-habitat-comp: Woody riparian corridor cover as a stand-in for habitat support (cover, wood recruitment, bank structure). It is not a field inventory of pools, wood, or bedforms. Sinuosity is shown for context.
definitions.population-support-biological-integrity-: Condition of the aquatic community, from measured benthic or fish results where available, otherwise a labeled model or landscape-integrity estimate.
definitions.community-dynamics-invasive-non-native-s: Extent to which invasive or non-native species are present in the watershed and may displace natives.
definitions.watershed-connectivity-fish-passage-and-: Mapped dams within a mile of the reach, as a sign of possible barriers to fish movement. Proximity alone does not establish whether a barrier is passable.

regionalDefinitions.low-flow-and-baseflow-dynamics-low-flow-: Unvalidated screening proxy for low-flow condition based on modeled monthly flow variability. It does not measure daily low flow or channel wetted connectivity.
regionalDefinitions.bed-composition-and-large-wood-substrate: Watershed agricultural cover as a pressure proxy for bed condition. It does not measure streambed grain size, embeddedness, fines, or large wood.
regionalDefinitions.population-support-biological-integrity-: Aquatic-community condition inferred from EPA's benthic-condition model where available, otherwise from complete landscape-integrity products. This is not a field biological assessment.

calculations.reach-inflow-concentrated-runoff-stormwa: From watershed road density, a directional proxy. It does not count outfalls or road-stream crossings.
calculations.streamflow-regime-flow-alteration-regula: Degree of regulation = upstream normalized storage relative to the annual runoff volume.
calculations.low-flow-and-baseflow-dynamics-low-flow-: Population standard deviation of all twelve EROM monthly flows divided by their mean. The CV is rated against NARS-9 reference curves, with a national fallback; this proxy is unvalidated.
calculations.high-flow-dynamics-floodplain-engagement: From the bank-height ratio (low-bank height ÷ maximum bankfull depth).
calculations.floodplain-connectivity-floodplain-acces: Entrenchment ratio = flood-prone width ÷ bankfull width.
calculations.hyporheic-connectivity-hyporheic-exchang: Better of the slope-pathway and sinuosity-pathway ratings (max of the two rating indices). A result from one pathway alone is labeled partial.
calculations.channel-evolution-channel-evolution-stag: Worse of the bank-height and entrenchment ratios. A canal or ditch classification rates Poor directly.
calculations.channel-and-floodplain-dynamics-bank-ero: From the bank-height ratio unless observed bank condition is entered.
calculations.sediment-continuity-sediment-supply-pote: Most limiting of agricultural cover, soil K-factor, and road density.
calculations.bed-composition-and-large-wood-substrate: Watershed crop plus hay cover, using the same 30/50 percent bands as Catchment hydrology. This is a disclosed correlated pressure proxy.
calculations.carbon-processing-detrital-processing-cp: Percent of the 100 m riparian buffer in natural vegetation (forest + shrub + grassland + wetland).
calculations.water-and-soil-quality-regulatory-impair: From the reach's Clean Water Act impaired-waters listing (303(d)/305(b)/TMDL).
calculations.habitat-provision-in-stream-habitat-comp: Woody riparian corridor cover binned to a rating. Sinuosity is displayed as context.
calculations.population-support-biological-integrity-: EPA prg_bmmi0809 probability from the other area of interest, using 0.25/0.50 bands. Where unavailable, the lower complete ICI/IWI integrity product is the fallback.
calculations.watershed-connectivity-fish-passage-and-: From dam/barrier presence affecting upstream-downstream passage.

STREAMCAT_INPUT_SOURCES.temperature.woodyRiparian: EPA StreamCat forest + shrub + woody wetland (rp100)

STREAMCAT_RESULT_SOURCES.flowAlteration: EPA StreamCat normalized storage + annual runoff
STREAMCAT_RESULT_SOURCES.sediment: EPA StreamCat agriculture + K-factor + road density
STREAMCAT_RESULT_SOURCES.temperature: EPA StreamCat woody riparian cover + watershed impervious cover

_ENGINE_INPUT_DETAILS.temperature.woodyRiparian: NLCD 2021 forest + shrub + woody wetland (100 m)

_ENGINE_RESULT_DETAILS.temperature: woody riparian cover + watershed impervious cover

_ENGINE_NOTES.flowAlteration: Runoff is the STAF site engine EROM-derived depth over the HR reach watershed, not StreamCat RunoffWs.

watershed.GUIDANCE_UNAVAILABLE: Watershed evidence is unavailable for this stream. The HR reach watershed could not be calculated ({reason}). Use SFARI or DEEP for this site, or enter a rating override.
